theme: small business: 5 Claude prompts for price questions (ready answers, starting price when it depends, 3 options, asked for cheaper, raising prices), tied to /guides/reply-to-price-inquiry/, leading to the free Front Desk Starter (/brain/) and the Front Desk Kit

gate.notes: Accuracy 26/30 (reply within an hour, nearly 7x as likely to qualify: 2011 HBR lead response study via SmartCompany + CrankWheel, phrased as 'land a real conversation' per HBR's definition of qualify; options let customers pick what fits needs and budget: Jobber + JobNimbus; change scope not price for the same job: Selling Energy + Home Service Pros; price increase with notice, real reason, no apology: Xero (30 to 60 days) + Simply Business (14 to 30 days), so the slide says 'a few weeks'; sample business and $180 price labeled SAMPLE). Hook 21/25. Clarity 18/20. Design 13/15 vs last 5 covers: first split white/black background, first centered headline, main visual is a giant incoming text bubble (vs stars, calendar, timeline, clock, boarding pass), mid scale headline (112px) under a 196px bubble. CTA 10/10 (AGENTS confirmed in config/manychat.json, gift per Front Desk focus override, no LAUNCH30, no parked agents). QA PASS after 2 fixes (contrast read against the white page until text carried its own background; HOW MUCH? too wide). All 7 slides read on a phone. No prompt repeats earlier posts.

captions.ig:
Most jobs start with a text that says "how much?". Here are 5 Claude prompts to answer it and book the job.

1. Save ready answers to your 3 most common price questions.
2. When it depends: a starting price and the one detail you need.
3. Give 3 options so each customer picks what fits.
4. Asked for cheaper? Offer a smaller job, not a lower price for the same job.
5. Raising prices: a few weeks of notice and the real reason. No apology.

Sample business shown is made up.

Comment AGENTS and we will DM you the free Front Desk Starter: replies to customers in your voice. It drafts, you send.

Sources: Harvard Business Review study (via SmartCompany, CrankWheel), Jobber, JobNimbus, Selling Energy, Home Service Pros, Xero, Simply Business.
